name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: This name will be displayed in the Homebridge log.

email.title: Email
email.description: It is recommended to set up a separate account for Homebridge and share the devices from your main account.

debugMode.title: Debug Mode
debugMode.description: When enabled, debug messages will be written to the log.

localControl.title: Prefer Local (LAN) Control
localControl.description: When enabled, devices reachable on your local network are read and controlled directly over the LAN, falling back to the Panasonic cloud only on failure or for unsupported commands. Requires a Panasonic CZ-T006/T007 Wi-Fi module.

localScanSubnet.title: Scan Subnet for Local Devices
localScanSubnet.description: In addition to SSDP, TCP-scan the local subnet (port 57223) to locate modules. Disable if SSDP alone already finds your devices or to avoid the scan.

localDevices.title: Manual Local Device Mapping
localDevices.description: Optional overrides mapping a device GWID (its MAC, 12 hex characters) to a LAN IP address. Use when SSDP is blocked (e.g. a different VLAN) or DHCP keeps moving a device.
